title: Offer or refer adults with BMI 30 or higher to intensive, multicomponent behavioral interventions

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians offer or refer adults with a body mass index (BMI) of 30 or higher (calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared) to intensive, multicomponent behavioral interventions.

action: Offer or refer to intensive, multicomponent behavioral weight-loss intervention

derived.min: 'adults' is not given an age in the text; interpreted as age 18 or older

all.quote: body mass index (BMI) of 30 or higher

derived.window: text gives no lookback period; latest BMI in the measurement year assumed

uncomputable.needs: documentation that the clinician offered or referred the patient to an intensive, multicomponent behavioral intervention (offers are not reliably captured in structured EHR data)
